records.law: Uttar Pradesh Regulation of Urban Premises Tenancy Act, 2021
records.heading: Security deposit
verified_rules: For residential premises, the security deposit must not exceed two months' rent.
For non-residential premises, the security deposit must not exceed six months' rent.
The security deposit is refundable when vacant possession is taken, after deduction of the tenant's liabilities.
